sample.task:
{MOUNT WILDWOOD}

Natsuki: “Man, this day is the worst - I don’t have a Yo-kai partner like the other two! Nate has Jibanyan and Whisper…Hailey has Usapyon…but I haven’t met any Yo-kai at all. Not to mention my phone’s been getting like, 200 messages per hour.”

???: “Hey…over here…”

(Natsuki looks around, but doesn’t see anyone.)

Natsuki: “Huh? Who said that?”

???: “Over here…by the big tree…”
sample.chosen:
Natsuki: "Alright, I'll check it out."

(Natsuki walks towards the big tree, her heart pounding with anticipation.)

Natsuki: "Who could be talking to me like this?"

(Suddenly, a small, mischievous-looking Yo-kai pops out from behind the tree.)

Yo-kai: "Ahaha! I've been waiting for you, Natsuki! I'm Yumeko, the Yo-kai of Dreams!"

Natsuki: "Yumeko? I've never heard of you before. What do you mean you've been waiting for me?"

Yumeko: "Well, I've been watching you from afar, and I noticed that you've been having a bit of trouble. I thought I could help you out!"

Natsuki: "Really? That's so kind of you. But how can you help me?"

Yumeko: "I can grant you a special power - the ability to see and communicate with Yo-kai. But remember, with great power comes great responsibility. You'll need to learn how to use this power wisely and keep it a secret."

Natsuki: "I promise I will. That sounds amazing! I've always wanted to be able to see Yo-kai. So, how do I activate this power?"

Yumeko: "It's simple. Just close your eyes and think of a dream you've had recently. When you're fully immersed in that dream, open your eyes, and I'll be there."

Natsuki: "Alright, I think I remember a dream I had about flying over the ocean. I'll give it a try."

(Natsuki closes her eyes and starts to visualize the dream. She opens her eyes, and Yumeko is standing in front of her, glowing with a soft light.)

Natsuki: "Wow, it worked! I can see you now, Yumeko. This is amazing!"

Yumeko: "Yes, it is. Now, remember to use this power responsibly. And if you ever need help, just call out to me, and I'll be there."

Natsuki: "I promise. Thank you so much, Yumeko. I feel like I've made a new friend."

Yumeko: "Indeed, we have. Now, go out there and have fun at Mount Wildwood! I'll be watching over you."

Natsuki: "I will! Thanks again, Yumeko. See you later!"

(Yumeko disappears with a wave, and Natsuki continues exploring Mount Wildwood, now able to see and communicate with Yo-kai.)

???: "I am Komasan, a Yo-kai from the countryside. I've been watching you, and I think you could use a friend."

Natsuki: "Komasan, huh? Nice to meet you! I'm Natsuki. I've been feeling pretty lonely without a Yo-kai partner. I'm glad you found me."

Komasan: "It is my pleasure, Natsuki. Together, we can face any challenges that come our way. Let's be friends!"

Natsuki: "Definitely! I'm so happy to have you as my Yo-kai partner, Komasan. Let's go on some adventures together!"

(Natsuki and Komasan high-five, ready to embark on their new journey as friends and partners.)
